purpose: Proves a touched criterion's bound tests are real: they enter only through the app entry and the shared harness, and at least one goes red when each Code Node symbol implementing the criterion is broken, so a test that stays green against broken code is reported vacuous.
responsibilities: resolve the scope: --acs, else the touchedAcIds of the newest REVIEW verdict reachable from HEAD, else the --fbs acIds
structural check over every bound test file of each touched criterion: imports, module mocks, and silent defaults in the Code Node symbols
mutation proof: for each symbol-level Code Node of each touched criterion apply stub-to-throw, no-op and call removal in a scratch worktree and run only that criterion's bound tests
print one verdict line, emit json, and with --record write rcf/verdicts/<h12>/test-strength.json for the reviewed head

interfaces.name: rcf audit test-strength
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf audit test-strength [--acs <AC id>[,...] | --fbs <id>[,...]] [--record] [--json] [--jobs <n>] [--mutant-timeout <seconds>] [--max-mutants <n>]
PASS: "test-strength: PASS <n> criteria at <h7>: structural <n>/<n>, mutants killed <k>/<total> (timeout <t>, notApplicable <a>)", exit 0. FAIL: "test-strength: FAIL <k> of <n> criteria at <h7>: <AC id> <reason>[; ...]", exit 4, reasons "imports <path> (not the app entry or the harness)", "mocks <specifier> (not a declared edge)", "silent default <name> in <path#symbol>", "vacuous: <operator> on <path#symbol> survived <k> bound tests", "no Code Node", "no symbol-level Code Node", "unbound". Usage exit 2: "test-strength: no rcf/test-strength.json; declare entry and harness", "test-strength: no scope; pass --acs or --fbs, or record a REVIEW verdict", "test-strength: <k> mutants exceed --max-mutants <n>; narrow the scope", an unknown AC id. --record refusals exit 4: dirty tree, or HEAD differing from the reviewed head outside rcf/verdicts/ and rcf/verify-reports/. Defaults: --jobs half the CPU count (at least 1), --mutant-timeout 120, --max-mutants 200.

interfaces.name: rcf/test-strength.json
interfaces.description: format: JSON in the project's rcf/ tree (criteria class, written by the test-author). { "entry": [ { "kind": "bin" | "module" | "worker", "path": <repo-relative path> } ] (one or more), "harness": [glob, ...] (one or more), "edge": [module specifier, ...] (the network edge, for example "node:http", "undici"), "clock": [module specifier, ...] (optional), "runner": [argv with <file> and <name> placeholders] (optional; default ["node", "--test", "--test-name-pattern", "<name>", "<file>"]) }. kind bin: the entry is spawned as a child process (a CLI such as rcf-lite: bin/rcf.js); module: imported by package name through the package exports map (a library); worker: the module the deploy configuration names as main, built as production builds it, invoked through the harness's fetch.

interfaces.name: TestStrengthReport v1
interfaces.description: fields: version (1), head (40-hex reviewed head), scope (acs | reviewVerdict | fbs), criteria (array of { acId, structural { result pass | fail, findings [string] }, mutants [ { symbol <path#symbol>, operator stubToThrow | noOp | callRemoval, result killed | survived | timeout | notApplicable, killedBy [test pointer] } ], result pass | fail }), totals { criteria, structuralPassed, mutants, killed, survived, timeout, notApplicable }, wallMs, node.

notes: Code Node shape and limits: docs/code-nodes.md (symbol paths :26-33, the mark-complete gate :89-110, "Semantic drift is invisible" :129, which this check answers). The judgement layer (each clause pinned, flag honest) stays with Review (ReviewVerdict adequacy).
name: rcf audit test-strength: structural check of bound tests and the v1 mutation proof over Code Node symbols of touched criteria
